_help: Usage limits per plan. Edit the numbers with Notepad; changes apply straight away. The owner chooses each account's plan on the Account page. storage_gb = space for videos kept; minutes_per_month = video minutes that can be analysed each calendar month; transfer_gb_per_month = GB of video streaming and downloads each calendar month (what hosting companies charge for); keep_days = videos are deleted automatically after this many days (0 = only the retention period in legal_info.json applies).

_server._help: Limits for the whole server. max_total_storage_gb = all accounts together (0 = no limit); min_free_disk_gb = uploads pause when the disk has less free space than this.
